source.title: Bounded compact and dual compact approximation properties of Hardy spaces: new results and open problems

accepted.question_text: For each integer n ≥ 0 and each real number r with 0 ≤ r < 1, determine the exact operator norms of I - K_n and I - P_r on the Lebesgue spaces L^p for 1 < p < ∞, where K_n is convolution with the n-th Fejér kernel and P_r is convolution with the Poisson kernel. Also determine the exact operator norms of I - K_n and I - P_r on the Hardy spaces H^p for 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞.
accepted.context_brief: Exact norms of Fejér and Poisson approximation operators on L^p and H^p

evidence.quote: Open problem 5.2. Let n ∈ Z+ and r ∈ [0, 1). Find the exact values of kI − KnkB(Lp) and kI − PrkB(Lp) for 1 < p < ∞, and of kI − KnkB(Hp) and kI − PrkB(Hp) for 1 ≤ p ≤ ∞.

accepted.question_text: For each 1 ≤ p < ∞, determine the exact operator norm of the backward shift operator B on the Hardy space H^p, where B is defined by (Bf)(e^{iθ}) = e^{-iθ}(f(e^{iθ}) - ˆf(0)). Equivalently, determine the exact norm of I - K_0 on H^p.
accepted.context_brief: Exact norm of the backward shift on H^p

evidence.quote: Open problem 5.4. Let 1 ≤ p < ∞. Find the exact value of the norm kBkB(Hp) of the backward shift operator.
Clearly, |Bf| = |(I − K0)f| => kBfkHp = k(I − K0)fkHp for all f ∈ Hp => kBkB(Hp) = kI − K0kB(Hp).

accepted.question_text: Determine the exact value of M(H^p), the bounded compact approximation constant of the Hardy space H^p, for every 1 ≤ p < ∞.

evidence.quote: Open problem 5.5. (a) Find the exact value of M(Hp), 1 ≤ p < ∞.

accepted.question_text: Determine the exact value of M*(H^p), the dual compact approximation constant of the Hardy space H^p, for every 1 < p < ∞.

evidence.quote: Open problem 5.5. (b) Find the exact value of M∗(Hp), 1 < p < ∞.

accepted.question_text: For the Hardy-Lorentz space H[L^{p,q}] with 1 ≤ q ≤ p < ∞, find a nontrivial lower bound for the bounded compact approximation constant M(H[L^{p,q}]) and improve the upper bound M(H[L^{p,q}]) ≤ 2 given in equation (5.9).
accepted.context_brief: Sharper BCAP bounds for Hardy-Lorentz spaces

evidence.quote: Open problem 5.8. (a) Let 1 ≤ q ≤ p < ∞. Find a nontrivial lower bound for M(H[Lp,q]). Improve the upper bound for M(H[Lp,q]) given by (5.9).

accepted.question_text: For the Hardy-Lorentz space H[L^{p,q}] with 1 < q ≤ p < ∞, find a nontrivial lower bound for the dual compact approximation constant M*(H[L^{p,q}]) and improve the upper bound M*(H[L^{p,q}]) ≤ 2 given in equation (5.10).
accepted.context_brief: Sharper DCAP bounds for Hardy-Lorentz spaces

evidence.quote: Open problem 5.8. (b) Let 1 < q ≤ p < ∞. Find a nontrivial lower bound for M∗(H[Lp,q]). Improve the upper bound for M∗(H[Lp,q]) given by (5.10).

needs_review.question_text_raw: Given the new upper bounds for Hardy-Orlicz spaces H[L_φ], obtain sharper information about M(H[L_φ]) and M*(H[L_φ]), possibly exact values or improved bounds.

evidence.quote: Given that the value of M(Hp) is not known, it would perhaps be too ambitious to ask about the exact values of M(H[Lϕ]) and M∗(H[Lϕ]). Nevertheless, we think it would be interesting to get more information on these quantities.
